quotes.text: Our Captain was the best tour guide! He was engaging, informative and most of all fun!! He made us feel very special, like vip guests and was just so enjoyable. Not only that but he was intuitive and did a fantastic job of making the trip enjoyable for all 4 of us

Charming and hospitable as a true southern gentleman should be. He was funny, knowledgable and amazing with my 90 year old mother who loved the excursion.Love that the tours are for 6 people or less allowing for a very personal experience for everyone aboard.

Booked the hour and 45 min private tour. Well worth it! We saw 3 different pods, one of which had over 10 dolphins! Our captain was very knowledgeable and we got so close to the dolphins. Our sons loved the tour, highly recommend!!

Our Captain was awesome! He made sure we spent our time out doing what we wanted most and allowed us to enjoy a family trip with our 4 year old and 6 month old! We created a core memory and will be booking another trip next year!

This excursion was amazing! Our Captain was the best! We caught several sharks, saw dolphins, and collected shells. He made sure everyone had a great time. I would highly recommend Dolphin Discoveries.
